acceptance: A list of each gh call made from a cell, with its purpose.
After the fix, the I5 shadow log of one wave shows no read of ~/.config/gh/.
No cell has the GitHub token in its environment unless the operator approved it.
fix: Find which cell steps call gh (router, build, audit) and why. Either remove gh from cells (the pipeline does the GitHub work outside the cell) or pass a scoped token through the manifest env allowlist; never a read of hosts.yml. Operator decides which before I5 enforce.
